name: team30
source: qualitative_30_unseen_sentences.csv from the team's Colab notebook chosen_merged_asl_pipeline_hybrid_1.ipynb (Maimuna/Raiyan, TODO §13)
hybrid_source: the notebook's recorded STEP 11 batch output: rules_v1 -> fine-tuned T5 (checkpoint thesis_hybrid_dataset1/model, not yet received)
reference_status: DRAFT, written by Claude on 2026-09-24 and not yet reviewed by the team or a signer. rules_v2 was written to the same conventions by the same author, so team30 is a development set for rules_v2, not a test set.
reference_conventions: ASL gloss order, uppercase English labels, one token per sign; multi-word signs as separate tokens (WAKE UP, TURN OFF, NOT YET)
time words fronted (YESTERDAY, TOMORROW, NOW, THIS MORNING, day names, TIME + number for clock time)
FUTURE only when no time word marks the tense
wh-phrase last (TIME WHAT, WHERE, WHY); yes/no-question modal last (YOU HELP ME CAN)
copula, articles, do-support and most prepositions dropped; FOR kept for a beneficiary (FOR MY FATHER)
discourse words kept: IF BUT BECAUSE BEFORE PLEASE
plurals singular except lexical plurals (CHILDREN); names are glossed as words (fingerspelling is decided by the lexicon, not the gloss)
